crossRefs.note: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much…
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was…
Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully…
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…
Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither…
For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:
“I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good…
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in…
But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
In all things be showing yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, be showing integrity, seriousness…
and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say…
not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

translations.web: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
translations.bsb: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
translations.kjv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
translations.asv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and righteously and unblameably we behaved ourselves toward you that believe:
